items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: my main trumpet player now is Kid Sheik. That's my main trumpet player.

ctx.x: Did you name the favorites in the brass band?

Well, they're always my favorite, but in the brass band I had Sheik and Orny Canyon Leonard. Sometimes used three trumpets, sometimes used two trumpets and three reeds and Jesse Charles. And used Clarence and I used Louis Couture or Willie Humphrey.

items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And put your name on here, huh? Yeah, Kid Sheet. [INTERVIEWEE] What's your right name?

ctx.x: Yeah, and I'm Dick Allen, but I'm going to let Sheet do the interviewing because Barry Martin wants this. All right. Just pick up the questions and just talk. Just go ahead and do it now.
Well, Harold, a little information on the bands, different bands. What brass band do you remember when you was a boy?
